name: My Sex Story
source:
My Sex Story is a game focused on the idea behind sexual assault against men. This story is based on a true story from the victim's actual perspective of the scene.

[From [url=https://spidakid.itch.io/my-sex-story]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《My Sex Story》是一款关注男性遭受性侵这一议题的游戏。故事改编自真实经历，以受害者本人对事件的实际感受与视角展开。

（来源：[url=https://spidakid.itch.io/my-sex-story]itch.io[/url]）
